title: WHEN THE MOON RISES, WE SHARE A MESSAGE
editorialDisclaimer: Original fictional editorial adaptation created inside the MoonWitness XV Creative Lab. This episode is NOT a recovered historical transcript, does NOT depict real users or sacred figures, and preserves incomplete observations without forcing final interpretation.
centralTheme: END OF AN ERA · CAPTURE → WITNESS → PRESERVE (Incomplete evidence remains honestly incomplete)

panels.characterPosition: viewer-right rooftop rail silhouette against deep nocturnal Moon City skyline
panels.composition: Wide 16:9 multi-plane Moon City nocturnal horizon; upper two-thirds hold open moonlit sky and drifting clouds for calm negative space, lower third anchors rooftop railing and Kuro Signal leaning in quiet idle watch.
panels.visualAction: Silver crescent moon hangs above layered urban cables and rooftop towers while Kuro Signal leans against the parapet rail with a quiet portable receiver.
panels.actingIntent: Establish stillness before the signal arrives; Kuro is restless but waiting on the night frequency.
panels.speaker: NARRATOR
panels.dialogue: No carrier wave on the upper band yet—only rooftop wind and iron cables.
panels.caption: 01 · MOON CITY ROOFTOP · ERA THRESHOLD: CAPTURE
panels.narrativePurpose: Anchors MoonWitness II World Rule 01: The Moon is the symbolic anchor of the Witness layer.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays static composite of Moon City skyline layers with Kuro Signal in resting rooftop lean pose (frame-01.svg).

panels.characterPosition: center-right medium framing at rooftop parapet
panels.composition: Asymmetric medium shot isolating Kuro's upper body and twin-ring headset antenna against dark sky so the sudden cyan spark reads unmistakably.
panels.visualAction: A brief cyan-magenta radio pulse strikes Kuro's left headset antenna; Kuro dips in anticipation and whips upright as hood drawstrings flare.
panels.actingIntent: Sharp cartoon anticipation dip followed by immediate alert snap.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Wait—sub-band four just keyed open! Short pulse, low power!
panels.caption: 02 · SIGNAL INTERCEPT · BEAT ANIM-A (FRAMES 01–03)
panels.narrativePurpose: Initiates the CAPTURE → CONNECT sequence with a sudden anomalous transmission.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Holds key reaction frame-03.svg showing Kuro's alert head whip and glowing antenna rings without flashing transitions.

panels.characterPosition: viewer-left three-quarter torso turn with foreground receiver inset on viewer-right
panels.composition: Split-focus comic composition pairing Kuro's focused squint with a high-detail foreground insert of the matte charcoal portable receiver screen.
panels.visualAction: Kuro raises the portable receiver to eye level; three cyan/magenta carrier bars lock in while two middle segments drop out into static.
panels.actingIntent: Shift from startle to concentrated curiosity as Kuro verifies the partial packet.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Three clean carrier bars... and two dead drop-outs. If I wait for a repeat, the drift will swallow it.
panels.caption: 03 · PARTIAL WAVEFORM LOCK · BEAT ANIM-A (FRAMES 04–06)
panels.narrativePurpose: Establishes that the captured signal arrives fragmented from the outset.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays held inspection pose frame-06.svg paired with static portable-receiver-closeup.svg overlay.

panels.characterPosition: left-to-right diagonal vault trajectory across rooftop gap to archive hatch
panels.composition: Full kinetic action stage framed by diagonal punk speed lines; follows Kuro from low runner coil through mid-air rooftop vault and smear dash to archive roof skid.
panels.visualAction: Kuro clutches the receiver to chest, coils low, launches across the moonlit rooftop gap in a high-energy courier sprint, and skids to a rebound halt at the archive loft doorway.
panels.actingIntent: Full cartoon squash-and-stretch agility contrasting Kuro's urgency against the still night city.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Hold the press, Vesper! Carrying a live fragment straight off the north array!
panels.caption: 04 · COURIER TRANSIT · BEAT ANIM-B (FRAMES 01–07)
panels.narrativePurpose: Embodies MoonWitness II Breath Electric energy—moving raw observation from rooftop capture to the archive.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays key mid-dash action frame-04.svg with static speed-lines-burst.svg framing and zero rapid frame strobing.

panels.characterPosition: Kuro foreground left shoulder; Vesper Ink waist-up center-right behind archive workbench
panels.composition: Over-the-shoulder interior framing looking past Kuro's ink-splattered hood onto Vesper Ink's warm lamp-lit zine workbench.
panels.visualAction: Kuro slides the portable receiver and printed paper transfer slip across the cutting mat; Vesper Ink looks down calmly and lifts the slip with poised brass stylus.
panels.actingIntent: Contrast Kuro's breathless arrival with Vesper's unhurried archival precision (strict waist-up workbench staging).
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Fresh off the relay! Listen to the cadence—we can patch the missing bars and run the headline tonight!
panels.caption: 05 · ARCHIVE WORKBENCH HANDOFF · BEAT ANIM-C (FRAMES 01–02)
panels.narrativePurpose: Transitions from field capture into the Witness Archive workspace.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays static over-the-shoulder desk handoff pose (frame-01.svg) over workbench backdrop.

panels.characterPosition: Vesper Ink waist-up center frame behind workbench
panels.composition: Balanced medium-close portrait of Vesper Ink waist-up under warm desk lamp; tinted forehead goggles catch cyan/violet reflections as she inspects the paper slip.
panels.visualAction: Vesper holds the transmission slip between steady fingers, tracing the decoded bars with her eyes and pausing at the torn gap notches.
panels.actingIntent: Quiet analytical focus; zero theatrical exaggeration—every micro-tilt shows disciplined editorial care.
panels.speaker: VESPER INK
panels.dialogue: Carrier header is intact. Timestamp mark is clean. Let's see what actually crossed the wire.
panels.caption: 06 · ARCHIVIST INSPECTION · BEAT ANIM-C (FRAME 03)
panels.narrativePurpose: Demonstrates careful source examination before any editorial claim is made.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Holds Vesper Ink waist-up analytical inspection pose (frame-03.svg).

panels.characterPosition: no character on screen; macro tabletop insert of transmission fragment slip
panels.composition: Stark high-contrast tabletop close-up surrounded by deep halftone negative space: three decoded cyan/yellow signal bars beside two unbridged torn-tape void slots.
panels.visualAction: The printed zine slip rests under magenta binder clips, clearly exposing two empty gap brackets where signal packets never arrived.
panels.actingIntent: Let the physical artifact speak: the missing segments are unmistakable and cannot be guessed.
panels.speaker: VESPER INK
panels.dialogue: Three verified clauses. Two unrecovered voids in the middle of the line.
panels.caption: 07 · INCOMPLETE ARTIFACT · MACRO EVIDENCE VIEW
panels.narrativePurpose: Visualizes MoonWitness II World Rule 03: Mystery, unknown, and unresolved states are valid parts of the universe.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Static macro display of fragment-slip-incomplete.svg over dark halftone background.

panels.characterPosition: Kuro leaning in eagerly from viewer-left; Vesper waist-up anchored on viewer-right
panels.composition: Split-energy two-character frame with an inset expression callout of Kuro's excited face against Vesper's calm vertical hand-and-stylus halt gesture.
panels.visualAction: Kuro lunges forward over the workbench corner urging an immediate speculative fill, while Vesper raises her brass stylus vertically to stop the rush.
panels.actingIntent: Peak acting contrast: courier excitement vs archivist epistemic discipline.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: We can infer the bridge from last week's frequency! Close the gap and publish the whole story!
panels.caption: 08 · TEMPTATION TO INFER · BEAT ANIM-C (FRAME 04)
panels.narrativePurpose: Stages the core editorial conflict between inventing smooth closure and preserving truthful boundaries.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays static two-shot reaction frame-04.svg with Kuro's excited expression callout inset.

panels.characterPosition: Vesper waist-up center-right tapping slip; Kuro settling back on viewer-left
panels.composition: Settled medium workbench composition; negative space opens above the desk lamp as Vesper taps the blank gap zones with her brass stylus and Kuro eases back.
panels.visualAction: Vesper lowers the slip to the blotter, taps the two unrecovered voids with her brass stylus, and frames the incomplete sheet cleanly with a yellow binder clip ready.
panels.actingIntent: Calm authority without scolding; Kuro absorbs the rule and nods.
panels.speaker: VESPER INK
panels.dialogue: A witness records what arrived, Kuro—not what we wish filled the silence. The gap stays marked as unknown.
panels.caption: 09 · WITNESS RULE · BEAT ANIM-C (FRAMES 05–06)
panels.narrativePurpose: Enacts MoonWitness II World Rule 02: A witness records an observation without forcing a final interpretation.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays held restraint pose frame-06.svg with Vesper framing the incomplete slip.

panels.characterPosition: Kuro viewer-left and Vesper waist-up viewer-right aligned over sealed zine folio
panels.composition: Harmonious two-character workbench staging with foreground detail of the sealed MoonWitness archive folio clipped in signal yellow and taped in hot magenta.
panels.visualAction: Vesper aligns the partial slip inside an archive sleeve and seals the corner with yellow binder clips and magenta gaffer tape while Kuro watches in quiet agreement.
panels.actingIntent: Collaborative alignment: courier and archivist share custody of an honest, incomplete record.
panels.speaker: KURO SIGNAL
panels.dialogue: Verified bars logged. Unresolved gaps bracketed. Ready for the night relay.
panels.caption: 10 · SEALED WITH GAPS INTACT · BEAT ANIM-D (FRAMES 01–02)
panels.narrativePurpose: Completes the PRESERVE → PROMOTE step—carrying forward only what deserves to continue without falsification.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays sealed folio pose frame-02.svg with archive-folio-sealed.svg detail prop.

panels.characterPosition: exterior rooftop relay mast center-left; warm archive loft window below
panels.composition: Nocturnal rooftop exterior with wide dark sky; the archive relay dish emits one rhythmic concentric cyan-silver ring above quiet apartment windows.
panels.visualAction: The rooftop relay indicator warms amber-cyan and releases a single calm concentric radio pulse across the night skyline.
panels.actingIntent: Environmental restraint—a quiet verified relay pulse rather than spectacle.
panels.speaker: VESPER INK
panels.dialogue: When the moon rises, we share the message—exact where it holds, open where it breaks.
panels.caption: 11 · NIGHT RELAY TRANSMISSION · BEAT ANIM-D (FRAMES 03–04)
panels.narrativePurpose: Connects the local archive workbench to the wider Moon City witness network.
panels.reducedMotionNote: Displays static rooftop relay warmup frame-03.svg without expanding ring animation.

panels.characterPosition: two tiny shadowed silhouettes inside warm distant archive window under expansive Moon City sky
panels.composition: Expansive final 16:9 nocturne with generous upper negative space, silver crescent moon witnessing the quiet skyline, and the warm loft window glowing below.
panels.visualAction: The faint radio ripple dissolves into night mist as the silver moon hangs over Moon City and the two archivists remain as quiet silhouettes in the distant window.
panels.actingIntent: Serene editorial closure leaving the unresolved signal gap honored in the archive.
panels.speaker: NARRATOR
panels.dialogue: The record is kept. The silence between the bars remains free to speak when its time arrives.
panels.caption: 12 · WHEN THE MOON WITNESS, WE SHARE A MESSAGE · END OF EP-LAB-01
